seams.title: Emit a proliferate event and add a 'whenever you proliferate' trigger
seams.clause: Whenever you proliferate, ... / When you proliferate, return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
seams.why: CR 701.34 proliferate is a keyword action with a CR 614 window (game/keyword_action.go, game/proliferate.go) but nothing is emitted after it: game/events.go says 'there is no EventProliferate at all' (#976), while scry and surveil have EventScry / EventSurveil. Expect a post-action EventProliferate (Actor = the proliferating player, fired even when nothing was chosen, once per proliferate of 'proliferate twice') from ProliferateForEffect, a WheneverYouProliferate helper in triggers_common.go, and the graveyard-zone form for Voidwing Hybrid.
seams.checked: grep -ri 'you proliferate' game cards/effects: 0 hits. grep 'Event[A-Za-z]*Proliferat': only the comment in events.go:888 saying it does not exist. 'Whenever you scry' has precedents (celeborn_the_wise.go, diviner_of_victory.go) on EventScry, so the shape to copy exists.

seams.title: Add the For Mirrodin! keyword helper
seams.clause: For Mirrodin! (When this Equipment enters, create a 2/2 red Rebel creature token, then attach this to it.)
seams.why: CR 702.163 has no helper and the keyword is unknown to the engine. Near-copy of LivingWeapon (cards/effects/living_weapon.go) with the existing token row '2/2 red Rebel' (tokens_table.go:286): add ForMirrodin(cardName) plus the printed keyword. Small, but 13 cards and two later batches (11, 14) share it, so it is built once here with the nine plain Equipment.
seams.checked: grep -ri 'mirrodin' game cards/effects: no keyword or helper (only set-name comments). grep 'func LivingWeapon': living_weapon.go:55. grep 'then attach (this|it) to it': 24 living-weapon style files, none creating a Rebel. Token row exists (barret_avalanche_leader.go uses TokenCard("2/2 red Rebel")).

seams.title: Add an 'exile a spell you control' activation cost
seams.clause: {1}{U/P}, {T}, Exile a spell you control: Target opponent reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a card with mana value equal to 1 plus the exiled spell's mana value. ...
seams.why: No AbilityCost moves an object from the stack to exile as a cost and remembers its mana value for the effect. Expect a new cost in cards/effects/activated.go beside ExileAPermanentYouControl / ExileFromHand, with the stack removal in game/activated.go and the exiled spell's last known mana value on the paid cost. The {U/P} in an activation cost already exists (game/activated.go).
seams.checked: Listed every 'func X(...) game.AbilityCost' in activated.go: exile costs cover permanents, hand, graveyard, library top and the source, none the stack. grep -i 'Exile a spell you control|ExileSpellCost|exile.{0,20}spell you control': 0 hits.
